responsibility: Provides AST-level expansion support data shared with macro expansion and later compiler stages by collecting the expand submodules, tracking items stripped by `cfg` evaluation, and defining the serialized AST representations used by specialized expansion-related features: allocator shim descriptions and canonical signatures, `#[autodiff(...)]` annotation parsing/validation and recorded autodiff items, and the type-tree summaries of Rust type and function layout that autodiff integration attaches to those items.
